messages:
maria: heads up — CI evals for the quantized Llama2 candidate started showing nondeterministic regressions. I can repro locally if I pause the runner and resume it. cc @chao @ben :eyes:
chao: can you paste minimal repro steps? is this only with quantized kernels or happens on fp16 too?
ben: quick notes: run eval harness with `--workers 4 --preemptible` then trigger SIGSTOP on worker 2, wait ~20s, SIGCONT. repeat a few times. Observed duplicated sample sequences across different requests after resume. Only seen on int8 path so far.
maria: example logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T02:14:03Z INFO worker=2 load_model quant=int8 seed=987654321
2026-03-15T02:14:30Z INFO worker=2 pause_for_preempt
2026-03-15T02:14:55Z INFO worker=2 resume_from_checkpoint checkpoint_id=ckpt-42 rng_state=ckpt.000
2026-03-15T02:15:10Z INFO sample request_id=abc123 seed=987654321 token=the
2026-03-15T02:15:10Z INFO sample request_id=def456 seed=987654321 token=the
```
chao: that log implies the resume path is restoring rng_state from the checkpoint and not re-seeding or advancing based on in-flight requests. Likely the worker restore routine calls `rng.restore(checkpoint.rng_state)` but doesn't apply per-request sequence offset.
nora: :grimacing: that would explain duplicates. If the RNG state is checkpointed at the time of pause, all resumed tasks will continue from the same PRNG point. For streaming/batched samplers we need a deterministic per-request offset.
ben: quick mitigation for CI: set `--sampler-mode=independent` which uses a per-request SplitMix64 seeded from (global_seed, request_id) instead of restoring a shared RNG. Might reduce throughput but should remove flake.
chao: agreed. Long term fix: change resume handler to stash checkpointed RNG as a starting point, then advance RNG by the number of tokens already emitted for that request before continuing, or reconstruct per-request RNG from `(global_seed, request_sequence_id)` so resume is idempotent. I'll draft a patch.
maria: can we also add telemetry that counts 'seed_reuse' events (when two samples in same eval share seed)? Right now CI only shows fail/success but not this signature.
ben: added a quick grepable log metric locally: `metrics.emit("sampler.seed_reuse", 1)` when we detect same seed across different request_ids. On our run it flagged ~24 events in 3k samples (~0.8%).
chao: patch sketch (will open PR):
```diff
- rng.restore(checkpoint.rng_state)
+ rng.restore(checkpoint.rng_state)
+ // advance per-request deterministic counter so resumed tasks don't clash
+ rng.jump_ahead(request.sequence_offset)
```
chao: if `jump_ahead` isn't available for our PRNG we can switch to per-request SplitMix derived stream: `request_rng = SplitMix(global_seed ^ hash(request.id))`.
maria: please open PR and route to eng-runtime + eng-ml reviewers. Also can we temporarily flip CI job to use `--sampler-mode=independent` and disable preemption on eval runners? That should calm the flake while patch lands.
ci-bot: deploy triggered: canary/eval-runner/patch-2212 -> started (job id: canary-2212).
ben: I'll run 5k samples on canary and post stats in ~30m. If seed_reuse metric goes to zero we're good to roll to main.
maria: thanks team — prioritize this for the next 6h window, it's blocking a few onboarding runs for quant experiments.
chao: noted, PR will land in the next 2-3h with tests that simulate pause/resume and assert unique seed per request.
ben: quick reminder: add a unit test that serializes rng_state + request meta -> restore -> continue, and assert outputs match continuous-run baseline. That'll catch regressions in future.
nora: I can add the telemetry dashboard card for `sampler.seed_reuse` so SRE/QA can watch during rollout.
